--- title: "Hands-on Exercise 7A" author: "ZHANG Xiaoyu" date: "June 3, 2026" date-modified: "June 4,2026" format: html code-link: true execute: eval: true echo: true warning: false freeze: true --- # **Modelling, Visualising and Analysing Network Data with R** ## **1. Overview** In this exercise, you will learn how to analyse and visualise network data in R. By the end, you will be able to: - Create and manage network graph data using **dplyr**, **lubridate**, and **tidygraph**. - Build network visualisations with **ggraph**. - Calculate and interpret network metrics. - Enhance network graphs using network measures. - Create interactive network visualisations with **visNetwork**. ## **2. Installing and launching R packages** ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} pacman::p_load(igraph, tidygraph, ggraph, visNetwork, lubridate, clock, tidyverse, graphlayouts, concaveman, ggforce) ``` ::: ## **3. The Data** ### **3.1 Importing network data from files** ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} GAStech_nodes <- read_csv("data/GAStech_email_node.csv") GAStech_edges <- read_csv("data/GAStech_email_edge-v2.csv") ``` ::: ### 3.2 **Reviewing the imported data** ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} glimpse(GAStech_edges) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Rows: 9,063 Columns: 8 $ source 43, 43, 44, 44, 44, 44, 44, 44, 44, 44, 44, 44, 26, 26, 26… $ target 41, 40, 51, 52, 53, 45, 44, 46, 48, 49, 47, 54, 27, 28, 29… $ SentDate "6/1/2014", "6/1/2014", "6/1/2014", "6/1/2014", "6/1/2014"… $ SentTime 08:39:00, 08:39:00, 08:58:00, 08:58:00, 08:58:00, 08:58:0… $ Subject "GT-SeismicProcessorPro Bug Report", "GT-SeismicProcessorP… $ MainSubject "Work related", "Work related", "Work related", "Work rela… $ sourceLabel "Sven.Flecha", "Sven.Flecha", "Kanon.Herrero", "Kanon.Herr… $ targetLabel "Isak.Baza", "Lucas.Alcazar", "Felix.Resumir", "Hideki.Coc… ``` ::: ::: ### 3.3 **Wrangling time** ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} GAStech_edges <- GAStech_edges %>% mutate(SendDate = dmy(SentDate)) %>% mutate(Weekday = wday(SentDate, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE)) ``` ::: ### 3.4 **Wrangling attributes** ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} GAStech_edges_aggregated <- GAStech_edges %>% filter(MainSubject == "Work related") %>% group_by(source, target, Weekday) %>% summarise(Weight = n()) %>% filter(source!=target) %>% filter(Weight > 1) %>% ungroup() ``` ::: ## **4. Creating network objects using tidygraph** ### **4.1 Using `tbl_graph()` to build tidygraph data model** ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} GAStech_graph <- tbl_graph(nodes = GAStech_nodes, edges = GAStech_edges_aggregated, directed = TRUE) ``` ::: ### **4.2 Reviewing the output tidygraph’s graph object** ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} GAStech_graph ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` # A tbl_graph: 54 nodes and 1372 edges # # A directed multigraph with 1 component # # Node Data: 54 × 4 (active) id label Department Title 1 1 Mat.Bramar Administration Assistant to CEO 2 2 Anda.Ribera Administration Assistant to CFO 3 3 Rachel.Pantanal Administration Assistant to CIO 4 4 Linda.Lagos Administration Assistant to COO 5 5 Ruscella.Mies.Haber Administration Assistant to Engineering Group Mana… 6 6 Carla.Forluniau Administration Assistant to IT Group Manager 7 7 Cornelia.Lais Administration Assistant to Security Group Manager 8 44 Kanon.Herrero Security Badging Office 9 45 Varja.Lagos Security Badging Office 10 46 Stenig.Fusil Security Building Control # ℹ 44 more rows # # Edge Data: 1,372 × 4 from to Weekday Weight 1 1 2 Sunday 5 2 1 2 Monday 2 3 1 2 Tuesday 3 # ℹ 1,369 more rows ``` ::: ::: ### **4.3 Changing the active object** ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} GAStech_graph %>% activate(edges) %>% arrange(desc(Weight)) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` # A tbl_graph: 54 nodes and 1372 edges # # A directed multigraph with 1 component # # Edge Data: 1,372 × 4 (active) from to Weekday Weight 1 40 41 Saturday 13 2 41 43 Monday 11 3 35 31 Tuesday 10 4 40 41 Monday 10 5 40 43 Monday 10 6 36 32 Sunday 9 7 40 43 Saturday 9 8 41 40 Monday 9 9 19 15 Wednesday 8 10 35 38 Tuesday 8 # ℹ 1,362 more rows # # Node Data: 54 × 4 id label Department Title 1 1 Mat.Bramar Administration Assistant to CEO 2 2 Anda.Ribera Administration Assistant to CFO 3 3 Rachel.Pantanal Administration Assistant to CIO # ℹ 51 more rows ``` ::: ::: ## **5. Plotting Static Network Graphs with ggraph package** ### **5.1 Plotting a basic network graph** ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} ggraph(GAStech_graph) + geom_edge_link() + geom_node_point() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex07A_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-9-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ### **5.2 Changing the default network graph theme** ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} g <- ggraph(GAStech_graph) + geom_edge_link(aes()) + geom_node_point(aes()) g + theme_graph() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex07A_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-10-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ### **5.3 Changing the coloring of the plot** ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} g <- ggraph(GAStech_graph) + geom_edge_link(aes(colour = 'grey50')) + geom_node_point(aes(colour = 'grey40')) g + theme_graph(background = 'grey10', text_colour = 'white') ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex07A_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-11-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ### **5.4 Fruchterman and Reingold layout** ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} g <- ggraph(GAStech_graph, layout = "fr") + geom_edge_link(aes()) + geom_node_point(aes()) g + theme_graph() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex07A_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-12-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ### **5.5 Modifying network nodes** ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} g <- ggraph(GAStech_graph, layout = "nicely") + geom_edge_link(aes()) + geom_node_point(aes(colour = Department, size = 3)) g + theme_graph() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex07A_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-13-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ### **5.6 Modifying edges** ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} g <- ggraph(GAStech_graph, layout = "nicely") + geom_edge_link(aes(width=Weight), alpha=0.2) + scale_edge_width(range = c(0.1, 5)) + geom_node_point(aes(colour = Department), size = 3) g + theme_graph() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex07A_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-14-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ## **6. Creating facet graphs** ### **6.1 Working with *facet_edges()*** ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} set_graph_style() g <- ggraph(GAStech_graph, layout = "nicely") + geom_edge_link(aes(width=Weight), alpha=0.2) + scale_edge_width(range = c(0.1, 5)) + geom_node_point(aes(colour = Department), size = 2) g + facet_edges(~Weekday) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex07A_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-15-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ### **6.2 Working with *facet_edges()*** ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} set_graph_style() g <- ggraph(GAStech_graph, layout = "nicely") + geom_edge_link(aes(width=Weight), alpha=0.2) + scale_edge_width(range = c(0.1, 5)) + geom_node_point(aes(colour = Department), size = 2) + theme(legend.position = 'bottom') g + facet_edges(~Weekday) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex07A_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-16-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ### **6.3 A framed facet graph** ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} set_graph_style() g <- ggraph(GAStech_graph, layout = "nicely") + geom_edge_link(aes(width=Weight), alpha=0.2) + scale_edge_width(range = c(0.1, 5)) + geom_node_point(aes(colour = Department), size = 2) g + facet_edges(~Weekday) + th_foreground(foreground = "grey80", border = TRUE) + theme(legend.position = 'bottom') ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex07A_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-17-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ### **6.4 Working with *facet_nodes()*** ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} set_graph_style() g <- ggraph(GAStech_graph, layout = "nicely") + geom_edge_link(aes(width=Weight), alpha=0.2) + scale_edge_width(range = c(0.1, 5)) + geom_node_point(aes(colour = Department), size = 2) g + facet_nodes(~Department)+ th_foreground(foreground = "grey80", border = TRUE) + theme(legend.position = 'bottom') ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex07A_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-18-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ## **7. Network Metrics Analysis** ### **7.1 Computing centrality indices** ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} g <- GAStech_graph %>% mutate(betweenness_centrality = centrality_betweenness()) %>% ggraph(layout = "fr") + geom_edge_link(aes(width=Weight), alpha=0.2) + scale_edge_width(range = c(0.1, 5)) + geom_node_point(aes(colour = Department, size=betweenness_centrality)) g + theme_graph() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex07A_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-19-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ### **7.2 Visualising network metrics** ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} g <- GAStech_graph %>% ggraph(layout = "fr") + geom_edge_link(aes(width=Weight), alpha=0.2) + scale_edge_width(range = c(0.1, 5)) + geom_node_point(aes(colour = Department, size = centrality_betweenness())) g + theme_graph() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex07A_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-20-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ### **7.3 Visualising Community** ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} g <- GAStech_graph %>% mutate(community = as.factor( group_edge_betweenness( weights = Weight, directed = TRUE))) %>% ggraph(layout = "fr") + geom_edge_link( aes( width=Weight), alpha=0.2) + scale_edge_width( range = c(0.1, 5)) + geom_node_point( aes(colour = community)) g + theme_graph() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex07A_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-21-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} g <- GAStech_graph %>% activate(nodes) %>% mutate(community = as.factor( group_optimal(weights = Weight)), betweenness_measure = centrality_betweenness()) %>% ggraph(layout = "fr") + geom_mark_hull( aes(x, y, group = community, fill = community), alpha = 0.2, expand = unit(0.3, "cm"), # Expand radius = unit(0.3, "cm") # Smoothness ) + geom_edge_link(aes(width=Weight), alpha=0.2) + scale_edge_width(range = c(0.1, 5)) + geom_node_point(aes(fill = Department, size = betweenness_measure), color = "black", shape = 21) g + theme_graph() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex07A_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-22-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ## **8. Building Interactive Network Graph with visNetwork** ### **8.1 Data preparation** ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} GAStech_edges_aggregated <- GAStech_edges %>% left_join(GAStech_nodes, by = c("sourceLabel" = "label")) %>% rename(from = id) %>% left_join(GAStech_nodes, by = c("targetLabel" = "label")) %>% rename(to = id) %>% filter(MainSubject == "Work related") %>% group_by(from, to) %>% summarise(weight = n()) %>% filter(from!=to) %>% filter(weight > 1) %>% ungroup() ``` ::: ### **8.2 Plotting the first interactive network graph** ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} visNetwork(GAStech_nodes, GAStech_edges_aggregated) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ### **8.4 Working with visual attributes - Nodes** ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} visNetwork(GAStech_nodes, GAStech_edges_aggregated) %>% visIgraphLayout(layout = "layout_with_fr") %>% visLegend() %>% visLayout(randomSeed = 123) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ### **8.5 Working with visual attributes - Edges** ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} visNetwork(GAStech_nodes, GAStech_edges_aggregated) %>% visIgraphLayout(layout = "layout_with_fr") %>% visEdges(arrows = "to", smooth = list(enabled = TRUE, type = "curvedCW")) %>% visLegend() %>% visLayout(randomSeed = 123) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ### **8.6 Interactivity** ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} visNetwork(GAStech_nodes, GAStech_edges_aggregated) %>% visIgraphLayout(layout = "layout_with_fr") %>% visOptions(highlightNearest = TRUE, nodesIdSelection = TRUE) %>% visLegend() %>% visLayout(randomSeed = 123) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: :::
